Batch scrape with one URL failing returns partial results

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/crawlberg/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	engine, createErr := pkg.CreateEngine(nil)
	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	urls := []string{`https://example.com/good1`, `https://example.com/bad`, `https://example.com/good2`}
	result, err := pkg.BatchScrape(engine, urls)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
